title: Clean Active Window Mark
description: Active window mark should be the same fine line as inactive chrome (1px border-element weight) but with primary (active-base) color instead of a thick ring-2 inset.
summary: Restored multi-tab split layout + stack CSS grid for continuous active left stroke. Inactive sibling tabs use z-20 (modeDockInactiveTabClass); active tab/chrome/gap/corner use z-10/z-0 so primary frame paints underneath. No cap-wide active border wrapping all tabs.
